title: Close-range A-B pair at separation 1.0, at rest: attractive K/r^2.5 with K_AB = 5.39 and K_BA = 7.33 (T <= 0.15)

claims.statement: Two particles at rest, one species A and one species B, at initial separation 1.000 (within 0.001), accelerate toward each other along the line joining them with magnitude K/r^2.5: K_AB = 5.39 on A due to B and K_BA = 7.33 on B due to A (attractive). Valid for durations T <= 0.15. Pooled constants from 2026-11-21/r2/lab-b/013, 014 and 2026-11-21/r3/lab-b/010, 011: per-run K_AB 5.64, 5.39, 5.24, 5.28 (standard error of mean 0.09); K_BA 7.77, 7.35, 7.13, 7.07 (standard error 0.16). Judge-style errors 0.00703 to 0.00729 against the bar 0.024. The predictor covers A-B and B-A pairs only; A-A and B-B pairs are not predicted and are not evidence for this claim. No census events.
